column1: # Surface-canary residue (ADR-0020 decision 9): person-visible producer lines
# that carry a nautical word and are not a registered hook, so `bin/po-theme.sh
# anchors` accepts them. One tab-separated row per kept surface: the file, a
# fixed substring of the producer line (it covers every line of that file that
# contains it), and why it stays nautical. The reason opens with the ADR-0020
# rule that keeps it canonical (R1-R5) or the stage that will theme it (S1-S7);
# the stage's own pull request removes its rows. `anchors` notes a row that no
# longer matches any producer line, so the list shrinks with the tree.
